events.name: GXY  MONKEY BUSINESS
events.description:
GXY MONKEY BUSINESS

Part of the MONKEY BUSINESS / MONKEY MADNESS trilogy of events Mon / Wed / Fri
at the same time

The event starts as a steady state ride but may build towards elevated power or
a mini race at the end of the event

EVENT DYNAMICS

Category - C

Power - 2.2 > 2.8wkg but expect the event to finish around 2.5wkg based on
a 75kg rider.

Fence - Will be set to KICK! used at the leader's discretion

Draft - Enabled – focus required to stay within the group

Sweeper - Yes! Red beacon and beacon support riders will have a GXY tag after
their name

ETHOS

We at GXY are committed to creating a culture of belonging, inclusivity and
compassion, empowering people to grow stronger, work together and support one
another to achieve shared success on Zwift

GXY – Here together, for you 💜

If you want to become a member and join our community to race, ride socially, or
both, please come and join ideally via our Facebook link:

https://www.facebook.com/groups/galaxycyclingclub/
https://www.strava.com/clubs/989894
https://www.instagram.com/galaxycyclingclub

events.name: GXY WELCOME TO THE WEEKEND - BANDED
events.summary: Part of our GXY Banded Events, as the name suggests, WELCOME TO THE WEEKEND is a Friday only banded ride.
events.description:
Part of our GXY Banded Events, as the name suggests, WELCOME TO THE WEEKEND is a Friday only banded ride.

These events will be course or time based with a 5 minute after party or cool down after the regular event ends

EVENT DYNAMICS

Category – E

Power – 1.0 > 5.0wkg you decide, just keep pedalling!

Fence – No

Draft – Banded draft, designed to keep the group together whatever power is generated by a rider

Sweeper – No

events.name: GXY  SHOOTING STARS
events.summary:
Welcome to our Friday 'fast is fun' group workout ride. This event starts out
steady state but may include power pyramids, intervals and maybe even a mini
race at the end. As there is no sweep assistance, staying in the draft is
essential to get the most out of this event

events.name: GXY 75 ENDURANCE
events.summary: Part of the GXY ENDURANCE weekend group of rides
events.description:
Part of the GXY ENDURANCE weekend group of rides

This endurance event on a week by week basis will either be for 75 mins, 75kms or course specific.  

Both Category C and Category D riders for this event will launch at the same time on the same course.  A gap will be created by the Category C group but the social chat will continue between both groups throughout the endurance ride.

EVENT DYNAMICS

Category	- C and D

Power 		- C 2.3 > 2.7wkg but expect the event to finish around 2.5wkg based on a 75kg rider
		          D 1.8 > 2.2wkg but expect the event to finish around 2.0wkg based on a 75kg rider

Fence 		- Will be set to KICK! used at the leader's discretion

Draft		- Enabled – focus required to stay within the group

Sweeper 	- Yes! Red beacon and beacon support riders will have a GXY tag after their name
